name: @chiefaia/sqlite-utils
description: Shared SQLite helpers for CAIA packages — better-sqlite3 wrappers for opening WAL-mode databases, applying idempotent file-based migrations, running scoped transactions, and caching prepared statements. Lifted from @chiefaia/mentor-event-bus + @chiefaia/librarian so the dozen workspace packages that already speak better-sqlite3 stop re-implementing the same five lines of pragma + migration logic.
